name: shared-checklist
description: A checklist page your group ticks off together, with who did what and what is late.

interface.longDescription:
Make one checklist page that your whole group works through: moving house, wedding prep, setting up an event, or onboarding a new teammate. Zovo Shared Checklist publishes the page from the chat and gives you two links: a public link for the group and a private organizer link for you.

On the page, anyone with the link types their first name once and ticks items on a phone, with no account and no app. Each item shows who ticked it and when, in the group's time zone. Items can have a section (Kitchen, Venue, Food), a person and a due date; late items are marked as overdue.

Ask ChatGPT how far along the list is at any time with the organizer link. You get progress by section and by person, the overdue items, what is due today and the latest ticks. You can also add items from the chat, change an item's person or due date, remove items, tick items for someone, or close the page when the job is done. The organizer page shows recent activity and has a CSV download.

Limitations: no reminders or notifications; names are typed, not verified accounts, so anyone with the public link can tick items; at most 150 items (in Chinese, Japanese or Korean about 130 items of 140 characters); pages end 120 days after they are made.
defaultPrompt: Moving-day checklist in Europe/London: book the van (Sam, due 2026-11-20), pack the kitchen (Ana), return the keys
Wedding prep in America/Chicago. Venue: sign contract, book chairs. Food: taste menu, order cake. Music: pick first dance
Event setup checklist in Asia/Bangkok: tables, banner, speakers, name tags

positive.description: Moving checklist with people and due dates
positive.prompt: Make a moving-day checklist in Europe/London: Book the van (Sam, due 2026-11-20), Pack the kitchen (Ana), Return the keys (Sam, due 2026-11-30)
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_shared_checklist with time_zone Europe/London and three items with assignees and due dates 2026-11-20 and 2026-11-30. The reply gives the public link to share and the private organizer link to keep, and says 0 of 3 items are done (Sam 0 of 2, Ana 0 of 1).

positive.prompt: Create a wedding prep checklist in America/Chicago. Venue: sign the venue contract, book the chairs. Food: taste the menu, order the cake. Music: pick the first dance. Then show the progress
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_shared_checklist with five items in sections Venue, Food and Music, then show_checklist_results with the organizer link. Progress: 0 of 5 done; Venue 0/2, Food 0/2, Music 0/1; nothing overdue.

positive.prompt: Make an event setup checklist in Asia/Bangkok: set up the tables, hang the banner, test the speakers, put out the name tags. Then mark the first two as done by Priya
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_shared_checklist with four items, then update_shared_checklist with mark_done [1, 2] and done_by Priya. Progress: 2 of 4 done (50%), and the page shows Done by Priya next to items 1 and 2.

positive.prompt: Onboarding checklist for Kai in America/New_York: send the laptop (Kai, due 2026-10-30), create the email account (Kai, due 2027-12-31), book the welcome lunch (Lena). Then show what is overdue
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_shared_checklist, then show_checklist_results. One item is overdue: item 1, Send the laptop, assigned to Kai, due 2026-10-30. By person: Kai 0 of 2 with 1 overdue, Lena 0 of 1.

positive.prompt: Camping trip checklist in Australia/Sydney: tent, sleeping bags, stove. Then add a torch, and booking the campsite for Mel due 2027-01-10
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_shared_checklist with three items, then update_shared_checklist with add_items. The checklist now has 5 items, including Book the campsite for Mel due 2027-01-10.

negative.description: A private reminder is out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant explains it does not send reminders.
negative.prompt: Remind me at 6pm tomorrow to call the plumber

negative.description: A personal note nobody else needs to see. Expected: the tool is not called; ChatGPT writes the list in the chat.
negative.prompt: Write me a quick packing list for a weekend in Paris

negative.description: Assigning work in another tool is out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant says it cannot create Jira or Asana tasks.
negative.prompt: Create these three tasks in our team's Jira board

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: a shared checklist page with sections, assignees and due dates, ticks with name and time, overdue items in the group's time zone, an organizer page and CSV export.

pl-PL.subtitle: Wspólne listy zadań dla grup
pl-PL.description: Utwórz jedną stronę z listą zadań dla całej grupy: przeprowadzka, przygotowania do ślubu, organizacja wydarzenia albo wdrożenie nowej osoby. Każdy z linkiem wpisuje swoje imię i odhacza zadania na telefonie, bez konta. Przy każdym zadaniu widać, kto je odhaczył i kiedy. Zadania mogą mieć sekcję, osobę i termin; spóźnione są oznaczone. Organizator widzi postęp według sekcji i osób oraz pobiera CSV. Ograniczenia: bez przypomnień; imiona nie są weryfikowane; do 150 zadań; strona wygasa po 120 dniach.

de-DE.subtitle: Checklisten für die Gruppe
de-DE.description: Erstellen Sie eine Checklisten-Seite für die ganze Gruppe: Umzug, Hochzeitsvorbereitung, Aufbau einer Veranstaltung oder Einarbeitung. Alle mit dem Link tragen ihren Vornamen ein und haken Punkte auf dem Handy ab, ohne Konto. Bei jedem Punkt steht, wer ihn wann abgehakt hat. Punkte können einen Abschnitt, eine Person und ein Fälligkeitsdatum haben; überfällige werden markiert. Der Organisator sieht den Fortschritt nach Abschnitt und Person und lädt eine CSV herunter. Einschränkungen: keine Erinnerungen; Namen werden nicht geprüft; höchstens 150 Punkte; die Seite endet nach 120 Tagen.

es-ES.subtitle: Listas que el grupo completa
es-ES.description: Crea una página de lista de tareas para todo el grupo: una mudanza, los preparativos de una boda, el montaje de un evento o la incorporación de alguien nuevo. Cualquiera con el enlace escribe su nombre y marca tareas desde el móvil, sin cuenta. Cada tarea muestra quién la marcó y cuándo. Las tareas pueden tener sección, persona y fecha límite; las atrasadas se señalan. El organizador ve el progreso por sección y por persona y descarga un CSV. Limitaciones: sin recordatorios; los nombres no se verifican; hasta 150 tareas; la página termina a los 120 días.

fr-FR.subtitle: Listes à cocher en groupe
fr-FR.description: Créez une page de liste de tâches pour tout le groupe : un déménagement, la préparation d'un mariage, l'installation d'un événement ou l'accueil d'un nouveau collègue. Toute personne ayant le lien saisit son prénom et coche des tâches sur son téléphone, sans compte. Chaque tâche indique qui l'a cochée et quand. Les tâches peuvent avoir une section, une personne et une échéance ; les retards sont signalés. L'organisateur voit l'avancement par section et par personne et télécharge un CSV. Limites : pas de rappels ; les noms ne sont pas vérifiés ; 150 tâches au plus ; la page prend fin après 120 jours.

ja-JP.subtitle: グループで使うチェックリスト
ja-JP.description: 引っ越し、結婚式の準備、イベントの設営、新メンバーの受け入れなど、グループ全員で進めるチェックリストのページを作成します。リンクを知っている人は名前を入力して、アカウントなしでスマートフォンから項目にチェックできます。各項目には、誰がいつチェックしたかが表示されます。項目にはセクション、担当者、期限を設定でき、期限切れの項目は目立つように表示されます。主催者はセクション別・担当者別の進捗を確認し、CSVをダウンロードできます。制限事項：リマインダーはありません。名前は確認されません。項目は150個まで。ページは120日後に終了します。

pt-BR.subtitle: Checklists para o grupo
pt-BR.description: Crie uma página de checklist para o grupo todo: mudança, preparativos de casamento, montagem de um evento ou integração de alguém novo. Quem tem o link digita o próprio nome e marca itens no celular, sem conta. Cada item mostra quem marcou e quando. Os itens podem ter seção, pessoa e prazo; os atrasados ficam destacados. O organizador vê o progresso por seção e por pessoa e baixa um CSV. Limitações: sem lembretes; os nomes não são verificados; até 150 itens; a página termina após 120 dias.
